### Removed
- **`backstage.catalogs` and the portal's `agent-deployment` catalog location** (giantswarm/backstage-catalogs#705). The connectivity chart's app-config registers no `templates/agent-deployment/template.yaml` location from giantswarm/backstage-catalogs, and the cilium Backstage policy opens `api.github.com` on 443 while `backstage.skillsRepositories` is set (the skill discovery's reads) in place of `github.com`, `api.github.com` and `raw.githubusercontent.com` while `backstage.catalogs.version` was set. `backstage.catalogs` is gone from both charts and from `components.backstage.omitKeys`; a set `backstage.catalogs` fails the meta chart's render, naming it. `make verify-wiring` asserts the refusal and the GitHub API leg. UPGRADE.md.
